description: Skills invoked as /1337:<skill>, an eight-voice output style pack with reply budgets enforced by a Stop hook, an always-on rule to evaluate requests before building them, visual routing (image, SVG, video and speech prompts go to an OpenRouter model picked from a Jev-ranked priced list), and an opt-in tiered mode that lets Jev pick the model tier per builder step.

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator mode
orchestrator.description: Keep the main session as a planner: lookups go to 1337:scout (Haiku), implementation to 1337:builder (model chosen per step), verification to 1337:checker (Haiku). Refuses main-session edits over 20 lines.

tiered.title: Tiered mode
tiered.description: Before every 1337:builder dispatch, ask Jev (TypeSafe's decision model, through skills/tier/route.py) which model tier the step needs: Haiku, Sonnet or Opus. Needs a stored OpenRouter or TypeSafe key; without one the session sizes steps by hand.
